description:
Get transactions for a session with optional filters.

Returns raw transactions LEFT JOINed with their classifications.
Use unclassified_only=true to fetch pages of transactions needing
classification by the FE. Use date_from/date_to for date range queries.

account.description: Only transactions from this account name, as get_accounts lists it; empty for all.

category.description: Only transactions classified in this category (e.g. "Schedule C", "Schedule A", "Personal", "Internal Transfer", "Duplicate"); empty for all. Ignored when unclassified_only is true.

date_from.description: Earliest transaction date to include, as YYYY-MM-DD; empty for no lower bound.

date_to.description: Latest transaction date to include, as YYYY-MM-DD; empty for no upper bound.

dpop_token.description: Proof that the caller holds npub. Either the grant envelope that receive_npub_proof returned, or the raw JSON of a kind-27235 Nostr event signed by npub: content "", a `u` tag holding this tool's exact name from tools/list, created_at within 60 s of now, and a random `nonce` tag.

limit.description: Maximum number of transactions to return (default 200).

month.description: Only transactions in this month, as YYYY-MM; empty for all.

npub.description: The patron's Nostr public key (npub1...). Tool fees are paid from this patron's balance; dpop_token proves the caller holds it.

offset.description: Number of matching transactions to skip, for paging (default 0).

search.description: Case-insensitive regular expression matched against the description, merchant and description override; empty for no search.

session_id.description: TaxSort session id (the UUID string create_session returns; list_sessions lists yours).

subcategory.description: Only transactions with this exact subcategory (e.g. "Office Supplies"); empty for all.

unclassified_only.description: True to return only transactions with no classification yet.

name: taxsort_get_transactions
title: Get transactions
